rapport_notes: Professional and attentive throughout a long, detailed commercial-office inventory; businesslike tone appropriate for a B2B caller.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer volunteered a real concern — "that's my main concern" about whether a large conference table fits through the doorway — and Jules responded "I think so. I would think so" with no follow-up before pivoting back to inventory.

top_strength: Took a thorough, patient item-by-item inventory of a complex commercial move and personalized the time estimate to the specific equipment involved (conference table disassembly, monitor testing, walk distance).
coaching_note: The customer flagged a real concern (whether the conference table fits through the doorway) and it got a one-line non-answer before pivoting back to inventory — that's exactly the 'asked the line but did nothing with it' pattern the rubric is built to catch.
